notes.title: Auf Auf
notes.notes:
It will not take much longer. The demo works and you can start hiking shortly.
In a nutshell: An object is hidden in the demo level that gives you a clue. Post it secretly in a group here in the community. With this hint you might see something interesting.
But I'll tell you what happens next in the fair. And after you get to know a few people in the forest, you voluntarily continue traipsing.
Have fun while playing.
